title: Emergency signs.
officialText:
Signs shall comply with the following:
1. Sections 8.11.8 and 11.2.4 of ASHRAE 15.
2. Refrigeration units or systems having a refrigerant circuit containing more than 220 pounds (100 kg) of Group A1 or 30
pounds (14 kg) of any other group refrigerant shall be provided with approved emergency signs, charts, and labels in
accordance with NFPA 704.
